rationale: Stop exposing external theme item properties (Control skips E.external items - ThemeDB has the external field in the fork). The paired FileDialog EXT hunk retargets Button's icon_color/icon_hover_color theme items which the fork base names icon_normal_color etc.; port the Control.cpp hunk and adapt/drop the FileDialog rename.
Fix Tree focus-item inline LineEdit offset (~19 lines in tree.cpp); self-contained, applies cleanly.
Reset Tree drag-unfold timer when the mouse exits; small fix, applies cleanly.
Fix TextEdit not drawing caret after setting editable; three-line fix, applies cleanly.
Add per-cell autowrap_trim_flags to TreeItem (Tree + one editor/debugger call site); self-contained, both scene and editor hunks apply cleanly.
Add ItemList.center_on_current(); small self-contained API addition, applies cleanly.
Hide TreeItem edit popup on scroll; one-line fix, applies cleanly.
Give Tree hovered_pos a negative default and reset on mouse exit; small self-contained fix, portable (nearby-context differs).
Fix inaccurate Tree relationship lines (~67 lines in tree.cpp/.h); self-contained rendering fix, applies cleanly.
Fix RichTextLabel table too wide with indentation; two-line fix, applies cleanly.
Loosen Control minimum-size check (invalidate last_minimum_size when hidden); small fix, portable (only nearby-context differs).
Fix LineEdit editability so it isn't limited to keyboard/mouse paths; self-contained, applies cleanly.
Fix copying text across tables in RichTextLabel; self-contained selection/copy fix, applies cleanly.
Fix RichTextLabel scrollbar when too small to show; one-line fix, applies cleanly.
Support tiling AtlasTexture in TextureRect (~42 lines); self-contained TextureRect enhancement, applies cleanly.
Fix TextEdit backwards search skipping matches; small self-contained fix, applies cleanly.
TextEdit no longer shows focus on some mouse events; tiny fix, applies cleanly.
FileDialog prints an error when changing to a directory out of scope; small self-contained guard, applies cleanly.
Fix RichTextLabel character click offsets after a table by tracking ItemTable::char_count; small self-contained fix (adds one member), portable.
FileDialog scrolls to selected file after a sorting change (adds ensure_visible_after_invalidating flag); small UX fix, applies cleanly.
Fix RichTextLabel [ol type=a] prefix generation; small self-contained fix, applies cleanly.
Make RichTextLabel item RID_PtrOwner a shared static (thread-safe) so RIDs are globally unique; one-line change, applies cleanly.
TabContainer set_current_tab should repaint immediately for visibility; port by making _on_tab_changed call _repaint() directly instead of the fork's callable_mp(_repaint).call_deferred().
Caret at end of word now works for lookup (> to >=) plus test update; tiny, applies cleanly.
Adds virtual Control._get_cursor_shape() override point; small, self-contained, relies only on GDVIRTUAL infra already in the fork (minor param-default context differs).

Fix RTL drag selection after double-click by setting is_selecting_text/click_select_held (both exist in base). Surrounding context uses the selection_mode enum from 116868; adapt the two added lines to the base double_click bool when porting.
Ignore IME updates and Alt sequences on read-only TextEdit; three small editable-guard hunks, portable (only nearby-context differences, no missing deps).
TextEdit rendering fixes with large line_spacing; small self-contained TextEdit change, applies cleanly.
One-line TextEdit fix for adding carets above then below; self-contained, applies cleanly.
Adds scroll_horizontal_by_default switch to ScrollContainer; small self-contained property, applies cleanly to fork (which has extra scroll-hint members nearby).

Overrides the PopupMenu internal ScrollContainer 'panel' style with StyleBoxEmpty so it doesn't inherit a global ScrollContainer theme style; fork has scroll_container. Note: place the override after the fork's scroll_container creation (no vbox_container in the fork).
After a full-line paste, updates scrollbars and adjusts the viewport so the caret stays visible; fork's _paste_internal full-line branch matches the parent. Self-contained.

Gives ItemList custom foreground color priority over selected/hovered theme colors so custom colors (e.g. script list hot color) show; reorders the txt_modulate if-chain. Fork has items[i].custom_fg. Self-contained.
Removes the unused TextEdit next_item_id member; fork has it only in the header with no cpp usages. Trivial cleanup.

Defers Tree incremental search so letter/Alt keys can act as shortcuts first (only searches if input wasn't handled); fork has _do_incr_search/incr_search and the matching gui_input path. Self-contained, adds one helper.

Ties the macOS screen-record permission box visibility to sampler_visible so it isn't always shown; fork's ColorPicker matches the parent (has constructor set_visible(false) and the unguarded macOS notification). Self-contained.
Replaces a single-case switch with an if in TextureButton::has_point; fork's has_point still has the FIXME switch matching the parent. Trivial cleanup.

Sets use_parent_material(true) on internal scrollbars of Tree/ItemList/RichTextLabel/GraphEdit/etc. so a parent material applies to built-in children; trivial one-liners in constructors, all nodes present. Self-contained.
Assigns cached tab metadata as each child is added rather than only on NOTIFICATION_READY; fork has pending_tabs/CachedTab and the NOTIFICATION_READY loop matches the parent. Self-contained.
Also emits ItemList.item_clicked when CTRL-deselecting a multi-selected item, matching normal click behavior; one added emit_signal in gui_input. Self-contained.

On focus-exit, deselect a non-editing LineEdit when deselect_on_focus_loss_enabled and not a drag attempt, fixing selection lingering on read-only fields; adds one else-if branch. Self-contained (standard LineEdit members present).
Preserves NAN in Range: _calc_value returns NAN early and set_value skips emitting when both old/new are NAN, so NAN no longer displays as 0. Fork has _calc_value/_snapped_r128. Self-contained.

Slider uses _is_focusable() (accounting for accessibility) instead of raw focus-mode check before grab_focus on wheel scroll; moves _is_focusable() to protected. Fork has _is_focusable and get_focus_mode_with_override. Self-contained.
Uses get_screen_position() instead of get_global_position() when placing the Tree edit popup so it isn't clipped by the window edge; fork has the matching call site (tree.cpp ~5212). One-line fix.

Adds using_native_touch to disable data drag-and-drop only for real touch input (not emulated), replacing the drag_touching check in can_drop_data/get_drag_data; fork has drag_touching and these methods. Self-contained, adds one member.
Draws the SELECT_ROW row rect only once per row via a should_draw_row_rect flag; fork's draw_item still has 'if (i == 0 && select_mode == SELECT_ROW)' matching the parent. Self-contained.
Guards RTL list/indent margin math with 'if (tab_size > 0)' to avoid a 1px indent when tab_size is 0; fork's _find_margin lines match the parent exactly. Self-contained.

Core fix is .ceil() on get_combined_minimum_size() before truncating into Size2i, preventing children with non-integer min sizes from being clipped; applies to fork's _resort. Note: the diff's surrounding max-size (propagating_max_size) lines are absent in the fork, so apply just the .ceil().

Connects SyntaxHighlighter changed signal to a new TextEdit::_syntax_highlighter_changed so highlighting refreshes when regions change; self-contained, fork has the syntax highlighting cache and set_syntax_highlighter. Shader editor call site is not a diverged area.
